summary: Normalize ASCII letter case in a report.
documentation: SQLite’s built-in upper changes lowercase ASCII letters to uppercase. It leaves other characters unchanged under the default build. NULL input remains NULL. Unicode-wide case conversion needs additional support.
returns: Text with ASCII lowercase letters converted, or NULL.
caution: The default function does not provide full Unicode case mapping. Do not use it as a universal name-normalization policy.
scenarios: Normalize ASCII stock-family codes in an export.
Create comparable report headings from imported short codes.
title: Display uppercase status labels
problem: From jobs(id INTEGER, status TEXT), return id and upper(status) as label, ordered by id. Use SQLite’s built-in ASCII behavior, keeping NULL as NULL.
goal: Use upper() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use upper for display and retain the original row identifier.
